audit.framing_9x16: Centered vertical crop on the streamer's webcam feed with a consistent background setting, utilizing quick scale-ins to emphasize facial expressions and reactions.
audit.subtitle_craft: Bold white center-aligned sans-serif captions with yellow keyword highlighting and distinct text pop-ups matching comedic beats, disappearing instantly when dialogue stops.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Subtle push-ins during hesitation and sharp, exaggerated zoom-ins on the eyes and mouth during comedic realizations or panic.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Minimal background music allowing dialogue to shine, punctuated by classic cartoon and comedic sound effects like lightbulb pops and suspenseful drumrolls.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Well-paced comedic buildup through hesitant reading, holding just long enough on the realization before cutting to panic and defeat.
standout_techniques: Dynamic zoom-ins timed precisely to facial expressions
On-screen pop-up overlays for chat messages with interactive reading elements
Strategic use of suspenseful audio cues before punchlines
Clean subtitle sync highlighting key words for comedic misinterpretation
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Overusing repetitive sound effects during minor movements
Excessive scaling that slightly degrades video resolution
